name: glass-xylophone
description: 滚动触发的玻璃琴音浪交互
tagline: Tap the Scroll, Hear Glass Sing.
interaction: As users scroll, translucent glass bars light up and resonate with tuned xylophone notes, creating a cascading visual waveform. Each bar's vibration ripples outward with chromatic dispersion and soft refraction, syncing sound frequency to bar height. The faster the scroll, the richer the harmonic layering becomes.
